release_notes: Unified Universal Release (macOS 13.0+): Single lightweight app supporting macOS 13 Ventura through macOS 26. Auto-enables Ultra-Light Mode on Intel Macs, macOS 13, and Low Power Mode (toggleable live in Settings), gracefully greys out macOS 14.2+ Audio Tap & Beat Haptics on macOS 13, and idles at 0% CPU when paused or hidden.
